svg.title: Zhuolun Li / Franklin
svg.desc: Backend, infrastructure, AI agents and evals. Isometric pixel art of a room in daylight: a developer in a red hoodie and black headphones at a white desk with two monitors, an oak floor, a server rack, a helper robot, and a chubby blue British Shorthair cat loafing on the bed.

g.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
